# Client tax table, 2026 (final)

Rates the client charges on invoices, in percent. Ontario's combined rate includes the client's eco levy from mid-year.

| Province | Rate | From |
|---|---|---|
| ON | 13 | 2026-01-01 |
| ON | 14 | 2026-07-01 |
| QC | 14.975 | 2026-01-01 |
| AB | 5 | 2026-01-01 |

An invoice's rate is the one in force on the invoice date.
